description: This is the main backend API source file for a Tic Tac Toe game, built using FastAPI. It defines API endpoints for authentication, game creation, moves, leaderboard, and game history, as well as app configuration and middleware setup.

classes.name: FastAPI
classes.description: Main application object for the FastAPI backend.

methods.name: health_check()
methods.description: Health check endpoint at root '/' to verify API is running.

methods.name: register(user: schemas.UserCreate, db: Session = Depends(database.get_db))
methods.description: Endpoint to register a new user with unique username and hashed password.

methods.name: login(form_data: OAuth2PasswordRequestForm = Depends(), db: Session = Depends(database.get_db))
methods.description: Endpoint to authenticate a user and produce a JWT token.

methods.name: str get_symbol_for_user(game: models.Game, user_id)
methods.description: Determine if the user plays 'X' or 'O' in a game.

methods.name: board_from_moves(moves)
methods.description: Create a 3x3 board representation from move list.

methods.name: check_winner(board)
methods.description: Check the current board to see if there is a winner.

methods.name: is_full(board)
methods.description: Check if the board is full (no empty cells).

methods.name: new_game(game_req: schemas.GameCreate, db: Session = Depends(database.get_db), current_user: models.User = Depends(auth.get_current_user))
methods.description: Create a new game, either single or multiplayer, with matchmaking for multiplayer.

methods.name: _game_to_response(game: models.Game)
methods.description: Convert game model instance to response schema, including moves.

methods.name: make_move(game_id: int, move: schemas.MoveCreate, db: Session = Depends(database.get_db), current_user: models.User = Depends(auth.get_current_user))
methods.description: Handle a move made by a user, including validation, move registration, checking for win/tie, and AI move in single-player mode.

methods.name: get_leaderboard(db: Session = Depends(database.get_db))
methods.description: Retrieve sorted leaderboard entries based on wins.

methods.name: get_history(db: Session = Depends(database.get_db), current_user: models.User = Depends(auth.get_current_user))
methods.description: Retrieve game history for the current authenticated user.
